thread.document:
With ChatGPT 5.1, I prompted an AI-assisted workflow for generating Anki flashcards that cover the foundational knowledge CS 182 expects (as checked by HW0): linear algebra, probability, calculus/gradients, and Python/NumPy. Useful for knowledge checks in preparation for the final exam. 

The idea is simple: give an LLM a structured “flashcard generator” prompt plus a list of prereq topics, and it returns Anki-ready cards that obey good spaced-repetition principles (active recall, one idea per card, concise fronts/backs, cloze deletions for formulas). I used this to build a “Path to CS 182” deck that you can import into Anki or extend for later homeworks.

The post includes:

The exact prompt I used to have the LLM generate and refine cards

Example follow-up prompts to fix multi-idea/wordy cards and check coverage against HW0 topics

A cleaned-up set of cards plus a short discussion of where the LLM’s output was especially helpful vs. misleading

You can reuse the same workflow to quickly build your own decks for new lectures or assignments while still critically checking the AI’s output.
